subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Hit the hay
solution:
The correct answer is option no. (2) i.e. **'To go to bed.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **Hit the hay** means to retire for the evening or to go to the bed.**(नींद में पड़ जाना/सो जाना ) **

 
 
• **Example:-** I usually** hit the hay **after the eleven o'clock.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is option no.**(2)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The idioms **get back at someone** means **to take revenge**.
